name: kanjiba
description: Offline-first PWA for drilling JLPT kanji and vocabulary, scheduled by an adaptive FSRS memory model.

scripts.ui:fresh: if curl -sf http://localhost:5210 -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null; then echo 'ERROR: something already serves 5210; refusing to audit a server I did not start' >&2; exit 1; fi; vite --port 5210 --strictPort & VP=$!; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf http://localhost:5210 -o /dev/null && break; kill -0 $VP 2>/dev/null || { echo 'ERROR: vite exited before serving' >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done; UI_BASE=http://localhost:5210 node scripts/ui-audit.mjs; RC=$?; kill $VP 2>/dev/null; exit $RC
